per_case_results.actual_sql:

    NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN "currency" = 'CZK' THEN 1 END), 0)::FLOAT AS ratio
FROM "customers"
LIMIT 500

per_case_results.question: What is the difference in the annual average consumption of the customers with the least amount of consumption paid in CZK for 2013 between SME and LAM, LAM and KAM, and KAM and SME?
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Segment = 'SME' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.CustomerID), 0) - CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Segment = 'LAM' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.CustomerID), 0), CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Segment = 'LAM' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.CustomerID), 0) - CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Segment = 'KAM' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.CustomerID), 0), CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Segment = 'KAM' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.CustomerID), 0) - CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Segment = 'SME' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.CustomerID), 0) FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK' AND T2.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(Consumption) FROM yearmonth) AND T2.Date::text BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT 
    AVG(CASE WHEN c."segment" = 'SME' THEN y."consumption" END) - 
    AVG(CASE WHEN c."segment" = 'LAM' THEN y."consumption" END) AS "sme_lam_diff",
    AVG(CASE WHEN c."segment" = 'LAM' THEN y."consumption" END) - 
    AVG(CASE WHEN c."segment" = 'KAM' THEN y."consumption" END) AS "lam_kam_diff",
    AVG(CASE WHEN c."segment" = 'KAM' THEN y."consumption" END) - 
    AVG(CASE WHEN c."segment" = 'SME' THEN y."consumption" END) AS "kam_sme_diff"
FROM "yearmonth" y
INNER JOIN "customers" c ON y."customerid" = c."customerid"
WHERE c."currency" = 'CZK'
    AND y."date" LIKE '2013%'
LIMIT 500

per_case_results.question: Which of the three segments—SME, LAM and KAM—has the biggest and lowest percentage increases in consumption paid in EUR between 2012 and 2013?
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Segment = 'SME' AND T2.Date LIKE '2013%' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Segment = 'SME' AND T2.Date LIKE '2012%' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Segment = 'SME' AND T2.Date LIKE '2012%' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END), 0), CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Segment = 'LAM' AND T2.Date LIKE '2013%' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Segment = 'LAM' AND T2.Date LIKE '2012%' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Segment = 'LAM' AND T2.Date LIKE '2012%' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END), 0), CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Segment = 'KAM' AND T2.Date LIKE '2013%' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Segment = 'KAM' AND T2.Date LIKE '2012%' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Segment = 'KAM' AND T2.Date LIKE '2012%' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
per_case_results.actual_sql:
WITH segment_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c."segment",
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(ym."date", 'YYYY-MM')) AS year,
        SUM(ym."consumption") AS total_consumption
    FROM "yearmonth" ym
    INNER JOIN "customers" c ON ym."customerid" = c."customerid"
    WHERE c."currency" = 'EUR'
        AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(ym."date", 'YYYY-MM')) IN (2012, 2013)
    GROUP BY c."segment", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(ym."date", 'YYYY-MM'))
),
segment_pivot AS (
    SELECT 
        "segment",
        MAX(CASE WHEN "year" = 2012 THEN "total_consumption" END) AS consumption_2012,
        MAX(CASE WHEN "year" = 2013 THEN "total_consumption" END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM segment_consumption
    GROUP BY "segment"
),
segment_growth AS (
    SELECT 
        "segment",
        "consumption_2012",
        "consumption_2013",
        (("consumption_2013" - "consumption_2012") / NULLIF("consumption_2012", 0)) * 100 AS percentage_increase
    FROM segment_pivot
    WHERE "segment" IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
)
SELECT "segment", "percentage_increase"
FROM segment_growth
ORDER BY "percentage_increase"
LIMIT 500

per_case_results.question: For the customer who paid 634.8 in 2012/8/25, what was the consumption decrease rate from Year 2012 to 2013?

    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN "date" LIKE '2012%' THEN "consumption" ELSE 0 END), 0) AS decrease_rate
FROM "yearmonth"

    FROM "transactions_1k"

)
